Choose the mode from workload heterogeneity, VM API needs, availability, image and update requirements before deployment.

options.text: Flexible manages standard VM resources and can support heterogeneous placement; Uniform manages scale-set-specific instances from a homogeneous model with a different feature surface.
Choose orchestration mode after the scale set is created.
Set minimum capacity above maximum capacity.
Set cooldown to zero for a workload with slow startup.

feedback.Reason: The resource model and feature compatibility drive the creation-time selection.

Details.mechanismOrProperty: The resource model and feature compatibility drive the creation-time selection.
Details.scenarioApplication: Flexible manages standard VM resources and can support heterogeneous placement; Uniform manages scale-set-specific instances from a homogeneous model with a different feature surface.
Details.errorCorrection: Orchestration mode is a creation-time decision. Autoscale capacity bounds must be internally valid. Autoscale can reevaluate before new capacity becomes effective and over-scale.
Details.boundaryOrTradeoff: Flexible and Uniform orchestration differ in instance resource model, supported features, and lifecycle behavior; the mode is chosen at creation.
Details.transfer: Choose the mode from workload heterogeneity, VM API needs, availability, image and update requirements before deployment.

items.prompt: What is the boundary between a scale set model update and an instance upgrade?
constraints: Manual, rolling, and automatic policies determine how scale set model changes reach instances and what health evidence protects availability.
Choose the policy with the application's health signal, maintenance control, and acceptable rollout risk.

options.text: Choose orchestration mode after the scale set is created.
Set minimum capacity above maximum capacity.
Use a load balancer probe that checks only TCP reachability when application readiness is required.
The model update changes desired configuration; the instance upgrade applies that model to already provisioned VMs according to the selected policy.

feedback.Reason: Publishing desired state and rolling it out are separate lifecycle events.
